summary.text: Chanel Branch is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former delegate from the district.
She served in the House of Delegates from January 2020 to January 2023 and worked for the Maryland Department of Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Chanel Branch's professional experience includes working as the director of support operations for strategy and administration for the Maryland Department of Human Services.
She assumed office in the Maryland House of Delegates, representing District 45, on January 28, 2020, and was assigned to the Ways & Means Committee for 2021-2022.
In the July 19, 2022 Democratic primary for District 45's three seats, Branch placed fourth with 22.4 percent of the vote and did not advance; she left office on January 11, 2023.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 2026 general election ballot for District 45.
